summary.en: Allow Cloud Project create from a git-less Workspace, treat production byRemote/pending 404 as unbound/empty, and reconstruct Desktop HTTP 204 without a Fetch body.
summary.zh: 允许无 Git 的 Workspace 创建 Cloud Project，将生产环境 byRemote/pending 404 视为未绑定/空列表，并用无 Fetch body 重建 Desktop HTTP 204。

compatibilityExceptions.reason: Mobile does not compose Workspace settings, the membership client 404 mapping, the Desktop HTTP 204 reconstruction, or the local://workspace sentinel used for git-less Cloud Project create.
